title: Single authorized publication of LearnIT V6 to existing GitHub Pages URL

Deployment only on the exact unique merge-title main push and run attempt 1.
Eight retired publisher workflows remain byte-identical and unable to publish.
Deterministic 52-file site assembled from pinned commit; no historic file deletion.
No learner data writes, IndexedDB delete or schema downgrade; preserve root origin.
No GitHub Pages configuration changes, new repository or Netlify.
Preserve historical deployment-evidence.json unchanged, not new V6 deployment proof.
Historical kit compatibility and additional WCAG tests excluded by human decision.
requiredEvidence: Exact two-file release PR and all four mandatory green CI checks
Twin 52-file builds and exact V6 root SHA256
Single GitHub Pages deployment on accepted main merge commit
limitations: Historic 52-file list cannot certify unknown external consumers.
Recovery/v3 is identical binary to V6 root, not independent of application errors nor Pages outage.
ChatGPT cannot directly fetch production URL; postdeploy Actions job must validate it.
Original OneDrive candidate S3 job remains HOLD; its attestation is not rewritten.
rollback: No automatic v2 downgrade over IndexedDB v3; any repair or rollback requires separate v3-safe human approval.
